intervals.label: data taking
intervals.note: Year precision; the experiment is described as in operation since 2016 and later talks report results up to 2023. No fetched source says it has stopped, so it is recorded as ongoing; last data-taking figure seen: 7.7 million IBD events by March 2023 (conference summary, not fetched).
intervals.quote: The DANSS experiment [33,34] has been operated since 2016 at a LEU reactor of 3.1 GW thermal power in Kalinin, Russia

placements.note: Campus-grade site point (the plant); see the site record.
placements.quote: The DANSS detector is placed under an industrial 3.1~$\mathrm{GW_{th}}$ reactor of the Kalinin Nuclear Power Plant 350~km NW from Moscow.

summary.plain: A block of about two and a half thousand plastic strips that glow when an antineutrino interacts, read out by light sensors, mounted on a lift so it can be moved closer to or further from the reactor.
summary.technical: Highly segmented plastic scintillator (2500 one-metre strips with Gd-loaded reflective cover), 1 m^3 sensitive volume, SiPM/PMT readout, composite shield; movable by a lifting gear between 10.7 and 12.7 m from the core.

technology.quote: DANSS is a highly segmented 1~m${}^3$ plastic scintillator detector. Its 2500 one meter long scintillator strips have a Gd-loaded reflective cover.
technology.value: Highly segmented plastic-scintillator spectrometer with Gd-loaded reflective strip cover, SiPM and PMT readout
